scientific_question: Can the current synthetic seismic physics produce a case-specific voxelwise P(label9 | d,x) in full-complexity StructuralGeo geology?

identifiability_branch.reason: The registered post-stack forward observes band-limited interface reflectivity at velocity-dependent travel times, not absolute impedance or homogeneous voxel interiors. A label9-vs-background feature likelihood additionally requires unregistered distributions over neighboring lithologies, geometry, thickness, orientation, and velocity. The acoustic codebook alone cannot supply those distributions.
